TableContent(2410–2424행)는 지정/사용자 columnWidths를 추정값보다 우선하고, 최종 active 폭을 반올림해 88–420px로 제한합니다(없으면 기본 144px). 이후 tableSizing.ts의 calculateTableSizing(32–61행)가 viewport를 채울 때 content 이외 열에 남는 폭을 균등 배분하고 나머지 1px를 앞 열부터 더하므로 실제 할당 폭은 숫자/날짜/장문/일반의 추정 상한을 넘을 수 있습니다. content 열은 이 추가 폭을 받지 않으며 App.tsx 2447–2452행에서 maxWidth 240px도 지정합니다. 전체가 content면 남는 viewport 폭은 열에 분배되지 않습니다.

화면·제품 스크립트·빌드는 실행하지 않았으며 실제 렌더링 폭은 검증하지 않았습니다.

policies.v3: Terminal searches and file reads are freely allowed. Before deciding whether to read an entire code file, determine with the terminal whether it exceeds 800 lines. Reuse an unchanged prior count, and count several files in one invocation if useful. For a code file over 800 lines use find_symbols and read_symbols for relevant callable/type bodies; batch multiple needed bodies into one read_symbols call. If an exact ID is already known, read it directly without listing. For a file of 800 lines or fewer you may read the whole file in the terminal when needed; whole-file reading is not mandatory. Imports, constants, settings, other non-symbol context, unsupported files or reader errors may still be investigated with targeted terminal reads even in large files. All those calls and retries are measured. find_symbols({relative_path,query}) searches only the specified file and returns matching metadata {id,start_line,end_line,signature,doc?}: the same native ID, original 1-based inclusive range and source declaration signature without body; doc is only the first sentence of existing attached documentation when present. It supplies no generated role, symbol kind, export flag or relationship. read_symbols returns selected exact code bodies, unchanged from v1. The required nonblank query is split on whitespace; every term must appear as a case-insensitive substring across id, signature or existing doc. It does not search body text, recurse, use regex/fuzzy matching, limit results or generate descriptions. The v3 lane has no list_ids tool. Known IDs can be read directly without searching. No expansion API exists.
